status.en: 20 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 55% fewer than the week before, most of them in Manila, Philippine and Davao.
status.nb: 20 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 55 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Manila, Philippine og Davao.

summary.en: China is threatening to cut undersea cables linking Taiwan and the Philippines while increasing patrols near Taiwan, and a Chinese vessel carrying unidentified equipment was probed by the Philippine Coast Guard inside Scarborough Shoal. The Philippine Coast Guard rescued a ferry in Quezon waters, delivered fuel to fishermen at Scarborough Shoal, and assisted over 150,000 sea travelers during the Undas period. Philippine officials criticised China’s inconsistent stance on UNCLOS and the South China Sea. The conflict remains low-intensity, with 176 battle-related deaths recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Kina truer med å kutte undersjøiske kabler som knytter Taiwan og Filippinene, samtidig som de øker patruljer nær Taiwan, og et kinesisk fartøy med uidentifisert utstyr ble undersøkt av Filippinenes kystvakt i Scarborough-revet. Filippinenes kystvakt reddet en ferge i Quezon-vann, leverte drivstoff til fiskere ved Scarborough-revet, og hjalp over 150 000 sjøreisende i Undas-perioden. Filippinske tjenestemenn kritiserte Kinas inkonsekvente holdning til UNCLOS og Sør-Kina-havet. Konflikten forblir lavintensiv, med 176 dødsfall knyttet til kamper registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
